g.title: MCU
g.text: GPIO1 goes to the battery divider; GPIO15 is unused

g.title: LORA
g.text: 470uF + 10uF + 100nF from VCC to GND, within 10 mm of the pad. RXEN pad left unconnected.

g.title: GPS
g.text: check the onboard LDO is not an AMS1117

g.title: Q1
g.text: 100k from G to S; GPIO6 low = GPS powered
